lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Birdie!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: We've got a small problem,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: so I need your help, Birdie!
Did you break another window?
Did you smash up a doorway?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: How is breaking a window a problem now?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A what now?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Oh, you mean those weird-shaped obstacles that are in every room.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: So that's what they're called. I've gotta remember that.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: we are conducting a rescue operation, and the building is on the verge of collapse.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Soooo, I'm trying to hold it up right now.
What?!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Get the Mighty Tools over pronto!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I may be a hero,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: but that doesn't mean I can repair buildings.
Wait, how are you talking to me right now?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I'm holding the building up with one hand while texting you with the other!
Use both hands, for goodness sake!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: You worry too much, Birdie!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: This is nothing for a hero like me!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I've been through much worse than this.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Have you ever seen the high-rise buildings in downtown Ark?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: One time, one of them nearly collapsed. Oh boy, let me tell you, I thought my goose was cooked then!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: If Maxwell and Drake hadn't arrived when they did, I'd have...
Stop texting and hold it up with both hands!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hahaha! All right, all right. Keep your shirt on!
Laplace doesn't answer for a long time...
Laplace!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: My arm's getting rather sore, so I switched arms.
